Private Function GV(ByVal o As Object, ByVal n As String) As String
    Dim v As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    v = CallByName(o, n, VbGet)
    If IsArray(v) Then
        GV = "arr"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        GV = "Null"
    Else
        GV = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
    Exit Function
Failed:
    GV = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function GO(ByVal o As Object, ByVal n As String) As String
    Dim x As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set x = CallByName(o, n, VbGet)
    If x Is Nothing Then GO = "Nothing" Else GO = "obj:" & TypeName(x)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    GO = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function G(ByVal o As Object, ByVal n As String) As String
    G = GV(o, n)
    If G = "E450" Or G = "E438" Or G = "E13" Or G = "E91" Then G = G & "/" & GO(o, n)
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, s As String, n As Variant
    Dim t As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1").Value = 5
    ws.Range("C1").Formula2 = "=SEQUENCE(2)"
    ws.Range("D1:D2").FormulaArray = "=ROW(1:2)"
    For Each t In Array("A1", "B1", "A1:B2", "C1", "C2", "D1", "D2", "F1:F3")
        For Each n In Array("HasRichDataType", "LinkedDataTypeState", "SavedAsArray", "Summary", "MDX", "CommentThreaded", "QueryTable", "ServerActions")
            s = s & "~" & G(ws.Range(t), CStr(n))
        Next
    Next
    wb.Close False
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
